fusions.name: Warning Cloud
fusions.desc: Releases a cone that deals 6 damage, leaves everything in it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 6 seconds, and has a 50% chance of [Damped] for 6 seconds. Your afflictions on a target spread to enemies within 4 tiles.

fusions.name: Reek Settles
fusions.desc: Deals 16 damage, up to 1.8 times that at maximum range, and uses up every affliction you have on the target for 50% more damage each.

fusions.name: Reeking Hide
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, 60% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it, and you move 15% faster for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Parting Gift
fusions.desc: Each time you are hurt by anything other than fire, a bolt strikes the nearest enemy within 5 tiles for 7 damage. Once every 15 seconds.
